summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed), and the full test/test_extras directory passes (97 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check and lint gates were not run; line lengths and import order were checked by reading. The with pytest.raises line has no arg-type ignore comment because isinstance narrowing should prevent the error; if mypy reports it, the ignore is needed there. No commit was made.
